errors.text_span: продължава да се движим по-ниско с леки колебания
errors.evidence: The phrase "продължава да се движим" is grammatically awkward. It uses the first-person plural ("we move") instead of the third-person singular ("it moves"), which should be "продължава да се движи".

Describing the red line (Private investments) as continuing to move lower after 2010 is an oversimplification. The line hovers around the value of 80 between 2010 and 2013, with a slight increase in 2012, before dropping again.
For the green line (Public investments), the value in 2009 is approximately 98, not 90. The value drops to approximately 90 in the following year, 2010.

errors.text_span: последван от рязък спад до 60 в 2016 година и леко нарастване до 90 в 2018 година
errors.evidence: This description of the green line (Public investments) omits the data for 2017. The line does not increase from 2016 to 2018; it first drops to its lowest point of approximately 54 in 2017 and then rises to about 88 in 2018. Missing the lowest point of the series is a significant omission that misrepresents the trend.
